text:
megan-marketing: Heads-up — platform reported elevated 5xx and slower embeddings responses starting ~09:12 UTC. Ops says degraded embedding indexer. Need customer-facing status page copy + timing. Can we get a short status and who will publish? :warning:

lucas-ops: Root cause: mem pressure on embed-pool01 causing queue backs. Working on rolling restart + demoting warm cache. ETA 45–60m. No data loss.

sarah-cs: Recommend notify customers at 30min mark for transparency. Suggest segmenting by SLAs (Dedicated) and free-tier.

raj-product: For messaging: emphasize "degraded embeddings retrieval" not inference. Customers using embeddings/semantic search will see increased latency and occasional errors.

megan-marketing: Draft options below. Pick one. Also need timing cadence: initial, update@30, update@60, resolved.

megan-marketing: ```
Status: Degraded — Embeddings retrieval
Impact: Some customers may experience increased latency or errors when retrieving embeddings and performing semantic search. No data corruption.
Workaround: Retry or fall back to cached results. We're deploying fixes.
ETA: ~60 minutes
``` 

anne-legal: Keep "no data loss" only if confirmed. Ops, please confirm.

lucas-ops: Confirmed: no persisted data loss. Will add that to public note once restart completes.

sarah-cs: For Dedicated customers, add note offering 1:1 outreach? I'll draft emails if we go with that.

megan-marketing: Cool. I'll publish initial status at 09:45 UTC (30m) unless ops marks resolved earlier. @ops-bot can you trigger post to statuspage and tweet channel when I publish?

ops-bot: scheduled_post created for 2045679190. Notified #marketing-twitter

lucas-ops: Progress: restarted embed-pool01 node-2, monitoring. Errors dropping.

raj-product: If errors <1% for 10m, let's update to 'partial recovery' wording.

megan-marketing: Ack. I'll hold on the 30m unless told otherwise. Thanks all. :pray:
